subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` fail closed on legacy ownerless rows, and what doctor or operator recovery path must upgrades provide?
rationale: Rows created before ownership metadata have no mechanically provable plugin authority, so the compatibility-versus-isolation choice requires explicit maintainer trust-policy intent.

options.title: Fail Closed With Recovery
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide a documented doctor or operator repair path that establishes safe ownership.

options.title: Preserve Legacy Access Temporarily
options.body: Retain prior plugin-runtime access until a migration can establish ownership without stranding existing sessions.

recommendation.title: Fail Closed With Recovery
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide a documented doctor or operator repair path that establishes safe ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history places the active session accessor and ownership invariant in their recent work.
